{{Quote|Sir, we have an incoming transmission from the Kolatill system.|Lieutenant [[Darryn Thyte]], receiving the Kolatill Council's distress signal|<ref name="O" />}}
The '''Kolatill system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], which was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kolatill]], which was the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] largest producer of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles and parts and a major stopping point on the [[Trition Trade Route]]. The system was locally governed by the [[Kolatill Council]] until [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], when it came under the authority of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

[[4 ABY/Legends|Six years later]], following [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the entire Kathol sector was withdrawn from the Empire by its Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], [[Kentor Sarne]], who set himself up as a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]. The Kolatill system subsequently became part of Sarne's fiefdom. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Kolatill's population rose up and overthrew their appointed [[Governor/Legends|governor]] after learning that the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|ousted]] Sarne from his [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]]. In the days following this act, they endured [[Bombing of Domaz|two]] [[Battle of Kolatill|attacks]] on their planet by [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] loyal to Moff Sarne, but were assisted by the crew of the New Republic [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''.

==Description==
The Kolatill [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Situated on the [[Trition Trade Route]], it was forty-six [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] away from the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] by Class One [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], or ninety-two hours by Class Two. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kolatill]]<ref name="O" /> and at least one other world.<ref name="Omens Explanation" /> The system was connected to the neighboring [[Torize system/Legends|Torize]], [[Oon Tien system/Legends|Oon Tien]], [[Corjain system/Legends|Corjain]], [[Charis system/Legends|Charis]], and [[Aaris system/Legends|Aaris systems]] via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] traveling from the Kolatill system took one day and four hours to reach [[Torize]], nineteen hours to transit to [[Oon Tien]], five hours to get to [[Corjain]], twenty-one hours to reach [[Charis]], and sixteen hours to get to [[Aaris III]].<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> The system was under [[Kolatill Council|local rule]] until it was subjugated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was controlled by the local [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], [[Kentor Sarne]]&mdash;in both his capacity as an Imperial official and independent [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]&mdash;until [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], when the local population overthrew their appointed Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] in favor of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="O" />

==History==
[[File:Tritiontraderoute.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Trition Trade Route, showing the Kolatill system in relation to the rest of the Kathol sector]]
The Kolatill system was under the rule of the Kolatill Council until the Galactic Empire took control of the system in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. The Empire placed Moff Kentor Sarne in command of the sector, and he appointed [[Tetrum]] as governor in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], supplanting the local government. Under Sarne's direction, Tetrum instituted a despotic regime, enforcing martial law and nationalizing all [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] companies&mdash;with the exception of the [[Politics/Legends|politically]] connected [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]]&mdash;to produce combat [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeders]] for the Moff's [[Moff Sarne's forces|military forces]].<ref name="O" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]],<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Moff Sarne withdrew the Kathol sector from the Empire and established himself as a warlord. The Kolatill system became answerable to Sarne only.<ref name="TDC" />

In 8 ABY, Sarne's capital, Kal'Shebbol, was [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberated]] by New Republic [[New Republic task force (Kal'Shebbol)|forces]].<ref name="TSB">{{DarkStryder|adventure=The Saga Begins|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> As news reached the Kolatill system of Sarne's defeat, the population of Kolatill rose up, overthrew Governor Tetrum, and declared their loyalty to the New Republic. In response, Sarne dispatched the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] ''[[Kathol Protector]]'' to the system. When the Imperial vessel entered the system, it launched [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] against Kolatill. The [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] [[Bombing of Domaz|assaulted]] Kolatill's capital [[City/Legends|city]], [[Domaz]], leaving it in ruins. Around the same time, a [[Unidentified starship (Kolatill system)|starship]] that was traveling in the system was attacked. The vessel was crippled and left adrift between planets.<ref name="O" />

Four days later, the New Republic [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' entered the system, responding to a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] broadcast by the Kolatill Council, which had been re-established to govern Kolatill following Tetrum's arrest. While the crew of the corvette offered aid to the citizens of Domaz, a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] patrol also discovered the derelict starship drifting between worlds and investigated in case there were survivors. As relief operations progressed, the ''Kathol Protector'' returned to the Kolatill system. The ''FarStar'' and its [[FarStar starfighter squadron|starfighter squadron]]&mdash;aided by the newly established [[Kolatill Defense Force]]&mdash;[[Battle of Kolatill|engaged]] the escort carrier and its complement of TIE bombers and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. The battle was fought both in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Kolatill and in its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The Imperial attackers sought to deploy disease-filled [[pathogenic bomb]]s against Kolatill's cities, but the combined force successfully defeated the ''Kathol Protector'' and its bombers, causing it to withdraw.<ref name="O" />

==Locations==
Kolatill was a stopping point on the Trition Trade Route, and its capital city was called Domaz. Kolatill's main industries were centered around the construction of repulsorlift vehicles and parts. Home to 400 million inhabitants&mdash;including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] and [[Jarell]]&mdash;Kolatill boasted varied terrain across its surface, including mountains, plains, wetlands, lowlands and [[Farm/Legends|agricultural complexes]]. The planet's axial tilt led to extreme seasons on Kolatill, including harsh winters and sweltering summers.<ref name="O" />

The Kolatill system contained at least one other planet besides Kolatill. Around the same time as the ''Kathol Protector'' first assaulted Kolatill, an independent ship was attacked and left adrift between planets.<ref name="O" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kolatill system was created for ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', a [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]]. The system was featured in the RPG adventure ''[[Omens]]'', which was the first scenario in the sourcebook. The system's prime world, Kolatill, was the primary setting for the adventure, written by [[Bill Smith]].<ref name="O" /> The system was later included in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''<ref name="TEA" /> and its [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|online companion]], which placed it in grid square M-21.<ref name="TEA-OC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

The exact number of planets in the Kolatill system has not been revealed. There are at least two, but the possibility exists that there may be one more. In ''Omens'', reference is made to finding a derelict ship "out between planets." Whether Kolatill itself is intended to be one of the planets in question is not stated, leaving open the possibility that there are two more planets in addition to Kolatill itself.<ref name="O" />
